gui.supportReport.RS-INST-01.title: Robbo Scratch was copied to this computer instead of being installed, so the USB drivers may be missing.
gui.supportReport.RS-INST-01.action: Install Robbo Scratch with the installer (.exe) as administrator. No internet is needed: the drivers are inside the installer.
gui.supportReport.RS-DRV-01.title: A device is plugged in, but Windows has no driver for it: {devices}.
gui.supportReport.RS-DRV-01.action: Run the Robbo Scratch installer again as administrator and keep the driver components selected.
gui.supportReport.RS-DRV-02.title: The device driver is installed, but Windows blocks it (often Memory Integrity in Windows 11): {devices}.
gui.supportReport.RS-DRV-02.action: Install Robbo Scratch 3.136.1 or newer: it brings a driver that Memory Integrity allows. Then unplug and plug in the device.
gui.supportReport.RS-DRV-03.title: The installer could not install a driver: {drivers}.
gui.supportReport.RS-DRV-03.action: Run the installer again as administrator. If it fails again, send this report to support.
gui.supportReport.RS-PORT-01.title: The device port is busy: {ports}.
gui.supportReport.RS-PORT-01.action: Close other programs that work with the device (Arduino IDE, a second Robbo Scratch window) and search again.
gui.supportReport.RS-PORT-02.title: Robbo Scratch cannot read the list of ports: the installation is damaged or incomplete.
gui.supportReport.RS-PORT-02.action: Reinstall Robbo Scratch with the installer.
gui.supportReport.RS-DEV-01.title: The port opens, but the device does not answer: {ports}.
gui.supportReport.RS-DEV-01.action: Check that the device is switched on and charged, try another cable and USB socket.
gui.supportReport.RS-DEV-02.title: The device answers, but the search did not recognise the answer: {ports}.
gui.supportReport.RS-DEV-02.action: Press «Search again»: some devices take a few seconds to start. If it repeats, flash the Robbo firmware: Devices panel → the device row → Flash.
gui.supportReport.RS-DEV-03.title: The computer does not see any Robbo device over USB.
gui.supportReport.RS-DEV-03.action: Check the cable (some cables only charge) and try another USB socket.
gui.supportReport.RS-LNX-01.title: Your user has no access to the device ports (not in the dialout group).
gui.supportReport.RS-LNX-01.action: Run «sudo usermod -a -G dialout $USER» in a terminal, then log out and log in again.
gui.supportReport.RS-WEB-01.title: This browser cannot connect to USB devices.
gui.supportReport.RS-WEB-01.action: Open Robbo Scratch in Chrome or Edge, or install the desktop version.
gui.supportReport.RS-WEB-02.title: No device was chosen in the browser window.
gui.supportReport.RS-WEB-02.action: Press «Search devices», choose the device in the browser window and press «Connect». If the device is not in the list, check the cable; on Windows it also needs the driver from the Robbo Scratch installer.
gui.supportReport.OK.title: No known problem found.
